blurb: Guests explore a spacious, heavily treed park with a huge variety of animals including giraffes, parrots, and tortoises. The park offers interactive feeding activities such as giraffe feeding, lory parrot feeding, and a petting zoo. Typical visit duration is 2-3 hours to see everything.
